schema.title: Machinations diagram elements
schema.description: A Machinations diagram: nodes joined by resource connections and state connections, as the documentation's reference names them.

NodeType.description: Nodes: Sources, Pools, Sinks, Converters, Traders, Gates, Registers, Delays, Queues and End Conditions.

GateType.description: Gates: Trigger Gates, Mixed Gates and Sorting Gates.

StateConnectionType.description: State Connections: Activators, Triggers, Node Modifiers and Formula Modifiers.

ResourceConnection.description: A resource connection moves resources from one node to another.

StateConnection.description: A state connection relays a node's state to another element.
